title: Virtual Public Workshop on Preservation & Progress Package A
description: Preservation and Progress is a comprehensive update to the City’s Heritage Preservation Program that aims to streamline review processes for new homes and other uses while continuing to protect places of historic, architectural, and cultural significance and encouraging their adaptive reuse. The initiative will be advanced in two parts—Package A and Package B. During this virtual workshop, City staff presented proposed updates to the Historic Preservation Element of the General Plan, revisions to the Historic Designation Appeal Process, amendments to the Complete Communities Housing Solutions Program, and a proposal to repurpose the existing Historic Preservation Fund to better support preservation work in underrepresented communities.
